Job.title: Job
Job.description: Architectural drafting project and plan package managed within My Plan Store OS

id.description: Unique identifier of the job record

owner.description: Lead owner initials or code e.g. JB

sq_ft_goal.description: Square footage goal or target range

current_status.description: Current lifecycle phase e.g. Construction Prints, Concept Design

sheet_status.description: CAD sheet progression status e.g. Elev Complete, Final Plan Ready

roadblock.description: Whether the project has an active blocker or holds

roadblock_notes.description: Detailed notes on what is blocking progress

next_step.description: Immediate next drafting milestone or action

total_duration_hours.description: Total tracked drafting duration in hours

total_duration_minutes.description: Total tracked drafting duration in minutes

hourly_rate.description: Hourly billing rate for drafting services

is_archived.description: Flag indicating if job is archived

target_completion_date.description: Estimated or target completion ISO date

TimeLog.title: TimeLog
TimeLog.description: Granular drafting work session and billing entry associated with a project

id.description: Unique identifier of the time entry

drafter_name.description: Name of drafter who logged the session

task_description.description: Description of work performed during session

billing_category.description: Category e.g. Standard CAD Drafting, Revisions

hourly_rate.description: Hourly rate applied to this entry

StaffUser.title: StaffUser
StaffUser.description: Authorized staff member, architectural drafter, or project manager

role.description: Designation e.g. Owner, Project Manager, Architectural Drafter

initials.description: Staff initials e.g. JB, KH, DL, GH

is_active.description: Whether staff member is currently active

can_mark_completed.description: Permission to approve projects as Completed

can_access_financials.description: Permission to view and generate billing rates and invoices

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Official billing invoice document issued for architectural drafting work

status.description: Payment status e.g. Draft, Sent, Paid, Overdue

DiscussionMessage.title: DiscussionMessage
DiscussionMessage.description: Internal team communication or project collaboration message

job_id.description: Target job ID or general channel identifier

sender_name.description: Name of drafter or manager posting the message

CompanySettings.title: CompanySettings
CompanySettings.description: Global My Plan Store OS company information, branding, and defaults

/jobs/{jobId}.description: Master collection of architectural drafting projects

/jobs/{jobId}/time_logs/{timeLogId}.description: Granular work session logs nested under each drafting project

/staff/{staffId}.description: Registry of authorized drafters, PMs, and system owners

/invoices/{invoiceId}.description: Official billing invoices generated for projects

/discussions/{messageId}.description: Live collaboration chat and project discussion threads
